title: The Monster
statementMd:
A monster is chasing after Rick and Morty on another planet. They're so frightened that sometimes they scream. More accurately, Rick screams at times $*b*, *b* + *a*, *b* + 2*a*, *b* + 3*a*, ...$ and Morty screams at times $*d*, *d* + *c*, *d* + 2*c*, *d* + 3*c*, ...$.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fa87bf740de4111cfce3f7bda62866ec8e2470d0.png)

The Monster will catch them if at any point they scream at the same time, so it wants to know when it will catch them (the first time they scream at the same time) or that they will never scream at the same time.

## Input

The first line of input contains two integers $*a*$ and $*b*$ ($1 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ 100$).

The second line contains two integers $*c*$ and $*d*$ ($1 ≤ *c*, *d* ≤ 100$).

## Output

Print the first time Rick and Morty will scream at the same time, or $- 1$ if they will never scream at the same time.

## Note

In the first sample testcase, Rick's $5$th scream and Morty's $8$th time are at time $82$.

In the second sample testcase, all Rick's screams will be at odd times and Morty's will be at even times, so they will never scream at the same time.
statementZhMd:
一只怪物正在另一颗星球上追赶 Rick 和 Morty。他们非常害怕，以至于有时会尖叫。更准确地说，Rick 会在时刻 $*b*, *b* + *a*, *b* + 2*a*, *b* + 3*a*, ...$ 尖叫，而 Morty 会在时刻 $*d*, *d* + *c*, *d* + 2*c*, *d* + 3*c*, ...$ 尖叫。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fa87bf740de4111cfce3f7bda62866ec8e2470d0.png)

如果他们在任意时刻同时尖叫，怪物就会抓住他们。因此，怪物想知道它将在何时抓住他们（他们第一次同时尖叫的时刻），或者他们是否永远不会同时尖叫。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$（$1 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ 100$）。

第二行包含两个整数 $*c*$ 和 $*d*$（$1 ≤ *c*, *d* ≤ 100$）。

## 输出格式

输出 Rick 和 Morty 第一次同时尖叫的时刻；如果他们永远不会同时尖叫，则输出 $- 1$。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，Rick 的第 $5$ 次尖叫和 Morty 的第 $8$ 次尖叫都发生在时刻 $82$。

在第二个样例中，Rick 的所有尖叫都发生在奇数时刻，而 Morty 的尖叫都发生在偶数时刻，因此他们永远不会同时尖叫。
